name: How do I choose between a rough framer and a finish carpenter for minor wall changes?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between a rough framer and a finish carpenter for minor wall changes?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should choose an integrated finish contractor who handles carpentry, drywall, and painting rather than a rough-framing-only specialist. Rough framing crews often leave heavy gaps and rough surfaces meant to be concealed by other trades later, which can cause alignment issues during trim and casing installation. A hands-on finish contractor like HH Remodeling frames rough openings with the final finish in mind, ensuring framing is plumb and square for door jambs, tile backing, and baseboards. This unified approach eliminates blame-shifting between separate drywall, trim, and framing contractors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor skilled in both framing and finish work to ensure rough openings are plumb and ready for seamless drywall, tile, and trim installation.
